sample.query: How should I choose shoes for everyday road runs?
sample.content:
Running shoes

The best running shoe depends on your fit, preferred cushioning, and the surfaces you run on.

For everyday road runs, look for a comfortable fit and cushioning that feels natural. For trails, prioritize grip suited to the terrain.

Try shoes on with your usual running socks. Leave enough room for your toes, and check that your heel feels secure.

Compare comfort, fit, and intended use before choosing. There is no single shoe that is best for every runner.

Why are prices different between your large and convenience stores?

Why are prices different between your large and convenience stores?

We're committed to offering competitive prices for our customers. Whether in our supermarkets, online or in a local store, we aim to make our prices clear, fair and appealing to our customers.

Different sizes of stores have very different operational requirements and running costs. Rents, for example, are often more expensive in our smaller stores due to their locations. It can also be more of a challenge to deliver products to our local stores.

These, and other factors such as staffing, local rates and a focus on convenience products mean there are differences in price between our supermarkets and local stores.

# Why are prices different between your large and convenience stores?

Why are prices different between your large and convenience stores?

We're committed to offering competitive prices for our customers. Whether in our supermarkets, online or in a local store, we aim to make our prices clear, fair and appealing to our customers.

Different sizes of stores have very different operational requirements and running costs. Rents, for example, are often more expensive in our smaller stores due to their locations. It can also be more of a challenge to deliver products to our local stores.

These, and other factors such as staffing, local rates and a focus on convenience products mean there are differences in price between our supermarkets and local stores.
